thread_title: S. flava v. atropurpurea/extreme red throat Okaloosa Co, FL
breadcrumb: S. flava v. atropurpurea/extreme red throat Okaloosa Co, FL

posts.body_html:
So, I have no clue exactly how this came to be: I crossed all of my original atropurpurea clones with each other in hopes of finding some better, hidden all red genes, and then this baby pops out! I also found some extreme red throat flavas without any red bodies, so this proves that the extreme red throat trait originated from atropurpureas....or at least that's one pathway to make ERT's.

Anyways, this is just a seedling, but holy sheet of paper maaan, it's pretty cool! S. flava var. atropurpurea/extreme red throat Okaloosa Co, FL, pics taken 5/5/21:


that trap in the foregound, left is a sibling, not the same clone:


These pics were taken right when the trap opened...the lid was yellow with some red to begin with, it's now solid red(not shown):


to be continued....
